subject: Request: Long-term pricing coverage & renewal protection for AmpliHealth
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@amplihealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@amplihealth.com, Priya Singh <priya.singh@amplihealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP follow-up — multi-year pricing request

Tessa — thanks for the conversation this morning. AmpliHealth is building our five-year roadmap and pricing stability is a hard requirement for our board. We're preparing an RFP package (attached) and asked vendors to propose two options: a 3-year standard and a 4-year strategic term.

Key asks for the 4-year option:
- Price lock on committed units for the term
- Annual uplift capped (we'd prefer <=1.5%)
- Renewal protection ensuring the first renewal isn't increased more than a small fixed amount if usage is within +/- 15%

High level commitment: $1.2M committed spend in year one, 18% growth forecast year-over-year on variable usage. We understand this is non-standard; please confirm whether Redwood can provide a commercial that includes a price-lock + renewal protection for 4 years, and what guardrails you would need.

Attached: AmpliHealth_RFP.pdf

Best,
Daniel
Director of IT Procurement
AmpliHealth

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@amplihealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up — multi-year pricing request

Daniel — thanks for the RFP and for laying out the asks. We can provision a proposal for a 4-year strategic term but it will require Deal Desk approval for deviations from standard uplift and renewal language.

Next steps:
- Ben (AE) and I will run the proposed numbers against committed pool modeling.
- Marissa (Deal Desk) — can you assess feasibility and recommended limits on uplift/discounts?
- We'll aim to surface an internal commercial (with model) by EOD tomorrow.

I’ll loop in leadership for sign-off if Deal Desk flags material deviations. Can you confirm the planned start date and whether your board requires a price lock to cover the full 4 years (committed + variable) or only the committed portion?

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Deal desk analysis — AmpliHealth 4yr request (pre-escalation)

Team — quick summary of what AmpliHealth is requesting and my assessment.

Request: 4-year term with price lock on committed units, annual uplift cap at <=1.5%, renewal protection for first renewal (if usage +/-15%, cap at +2% on committed baseline). They also want a guaranteed unit price for variable overage tiers.

Commercial impact (high level):
- Year 1 committed ARR: $1.2M (committed), variable estimated $200k
- Standard uplift cap we recommend: 3.0% annually; requested 1.5% is materially tighter and increases exposure on CPI/hardware costs and model price pressure.
- Discount ask: they expect a preferential discount for a 4-year strategic term; current pricing would require an incremental discount (approx. 10–20% on committed bucket) to reach acceptable net present value for them

Recommended approval path and guardrails:
1) Approve 4-year price lock on committed units only (not on variable overage tiers).
2) Annual uplift cap: approve 1.5% only with the following conditions: a) include a cost-pass-through clause tied to model or infra costs beyond a 250bps delta vs. baseline; b) limit total uplift protection to committed bucket (variable billed at list with tiered caps).
3) Renewal protection: allow first renewal cap at +2% if usage is within +/-15% of forecast. If usage deviates >15%, default renewal escalator to negotiated standard (up to 5%).
4) Cap cumulative discount across term to 18% on committed portion to protect margin (legal to define exact language).
5) Require DocuSign + 60-day audit rights clause and a short early-termination fee if customer elects to exit before 24 months (protects us on capacity allocation).

Attachments: pricing_model_v3.xlsx (detailed NPV and margin impact)

If leadership signs off on these guardrails, I recommend we present the commercial to the customer as a redline-ready term sheet. If leadership declines, we counter with standard 3-year or 4-year at 3% uplift.

-Marissa
Senior Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deal desk analysis — AmpliHealth 4yr request (pre-escalation)

Thanks Marissa — thorough analysis. I'm supportive of the recommended guardrails with the following executive directives:

1) Approve the 4-year committed price lock with the 1.5% annual uplift cap provided Legal signs off on the cost-pass-through and early-termination protection language.
2) Limit aggregate term discount to no more than 18% on the committed bucket; any incremental concession above that requires CS and Finance sign-off.
3) Require a quarterly usage review cadence and an audit clause in the contract to verify committed baseline usage (to mitigate underreporting risk).

Laura — please confirm the finance/recognition impact and whether 18% is acceptable from a revenue assurance perspective. If finance flags concerns, we'll fallback to 3% uplift for 4yr or 4yr at 1.5% only with an increased early-termination fee.

I'll loop Legal for contract language. Marissa, please prepare the redline-ready term sheet and send the DocuSign link once Legal confirms language.

-Rishi
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Proposal: 4yr strategic term — committed price protection (AMH-4372)

Daniel — appreciate the patience. Attached is the commercial summary and a redline-ready term sheet reflecting the internal approvals:

Summary of agreed commercial (for committed units only):
- Term: 4 years starting 2027-01-01
- Committed ARR Year 1: $1,200,000
- Annual uplift cap on committed units: 1.5% (cost-pass-through carveout for material infra/model cost changes >2.5 percentage points)
- Renewal protection: first renewal limited to +2% on committed baseline if usage is within +/-15% of forecast; otherwise standard escalators apply
- Aggregate discount cap: 18% on committed bucket across the term
- Early termination: customer pays remaining committed churn protection fee if they exit before 24 months (details in term sheet)

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/embedded/transactions/ABCDEFG123456
Attached: signed_master_agreement_amplihealth_draft.pdf (redline).

If this looks good I can kick off DocuSign today and we can schedule a kickoff the week of Jan 3.

Thanks,
Ben Carter

Redwood Inference
